159	    def init_layer_cpu_buffers(self, layer, layer_moe_idx: int):
160	        """Allocate CPU weight + scale/offset buffers for one MoE layer.
161	
162	        Called from AscendFusedMoE.__init__ after device tensors are set up,
163	        so CPU buffers exist before the safetensors weight loader runs.
164	        """
165	        ntotal = layer.global_num_experts
166	        if self.num_total_experts is None:
167	            self.num_total_experts = ntotal
168	        assert ntotal == self.num_total_experts, \
169	            f"MoE layers must have same expert count: {ntotal} vs {self.num_total_experts}"
170	
171	        params_dtype = layer.w13_weight.dtype
172	        # Use logical dimensions (layer.hidden_size / intermediate_size)
173	        # rather than device tensor shapes.  Device tensor layout may be
174	        # transposed before process_weights_after_loading (e.g. W8A8
175	        # stores [intermediate, hidden] pre-transpose), confusing the
176	        # per-expert shape derivation.
177	        w13_shape = (layer.hidden_size, 2 * layer.intermediate_size_per_partition)
178	        w2_shape = (layer.intermediate_size_per_partition, layer.hidden_size)
179	
180	        w13_list = [
181	            torch.empty(w13_shape, dtype=params_dtype, device="cpu", pin_memory=True)
182	            for _ in range(ntotal)
183	        ]
184	        w2_list = [
185	            torch.empty(w2_shape, dtype=params_dtype, device="cpu", pin_memory=True)
186	            for _ in range(ntotal)
187	        ]
188	        self.w13_weights_cpu.append(w13_list)
189	        self.w2_weights_cpu.append(w2_list)
190	
191	        # Per-expert storage size in bytes. The expert shape is uniform across
192	        # layers (asserted above), so this is set unconditionally on the first
193	        # layer and reused. Used for raw-storage slicing during NZ paging.
194	        self.w13_expert_size_bytes = w13_list[0].nelement() * w13_list[0].element_size()
195	        self.w2_expert_size_bytes = w2_list[0].nelement() * w2_list[0].element_size()
196	
197	        # Scale / offset CPU buffers (W8A8)
198	        self._init_layer_scale_buffers(layer, layer_moe_idx, ntotal)
199	
200	        self.moe_layers.append(layer)
201	
202	    def _init_layer_scale_buffers(self, layer, layer_moe_idx: int,
203	                                   ntotal: int):
204	        """Allocate CPU scale/offset buffers for a single MoE layer."""
205	        attr_specs = [
206	            ("scale_cpu_buffers", "w13_weight_scale"),
207	            ("scale_cpu_buffers", "w2_weight_scale"),
208	            ("offset_cpu_buffers", "w13_weight_offset"),
209	            ("offset_cpu_buffers", "w2_weight_offset"),
210	        ]
211	        for buffer_dict_name, attr_name in attr_specs:
212	            if not hasattr(layer, attr_name):
213	                continue
214	            dev_tensor = getattr(layer, attr_name)
215	            # Match the device slot shape the buffer is paged into. The W8A8
216	            # path flattens each expert's scale/offset to 1D (.view(E, -1)) in
217	            # its process_weights_after_loading, which runs AFTER this alloc
218	            # (pre-flatten, shape [.., 1]). Allocate 1D so the buffer already
219	            # matches the post-flatten device slot — no reshape at copy time.
220	            per_expert_shape = (dev_tensor[0].numel(),)
221	            dtype = dev_tensor.dtype
222	            buffer_dict: dict = getattr(self, buffer_dict_name)
223	            if attr_name not in buffer_dict:
224	                buffer_dict[attr_name] = []
225	            buffers = buffer_dict[attr_name]
226	            while len(buffers) <= layer_moe_idx:
227	                buffers.append([])
228	            for _ in range(ntotal):
229	                buffers[layer_moe_idx].append(
230	                    torch.empty(per_expert_shape, dtype=dtype,
231	                                device="cpu", pin_memory=True))
232	
233	    def _finalize_offload(self, model):
234	        """Post-weight-loading finalization.
235	
236	        Must be called AFTER get_model() has finished loading all weights.
237	        Performs NZ format conversion, cache policy init, forward buffer
238	        init, fp32 scale refresh, prefill pool creation, and gate weight
239	        registration.
240	        """
241	        if not self.moe_layers:
242	            return
243	        # Barrier: ensure all deferred load_w13/load_w2/_load_scale_shard
244	        # copies have landed before process_weights_after_loading reads them.
245	        self.drain_load_pool()
246	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
247	        logger.info(
248	            "[OFFLOAD] weight load (safetensors→CPU buffer): %.1fs over %d calls",
249	            self._weight_load_secs, self._weight_load_calls)
250	        t1 = time.perf_counter()
251	        self.process_weights_after_loading()
252	        t2 = time.perf_counter()
253	
254	        num_moe_layers = len(self.moe_layers)
255	        if self.offload_config.cache_policy_enabled:
256	            self.cache_requests = [0 for _ in range(num_moe_layers)]
257	            self.cache_hits = [0 for _ in range(num_moe_layers)]
258	            self.cache_misses = [0 for _ in range(num_moe_layers)]
259	            self.cache_calls = [0 for _ in range(num_moe_layers)]
260	            self.last_hit_experts = [[] for _ in range(num_moe_layers)]
261	            self.last_miss_experts = [[] for _ in range(num_moe_layers)]
262	            self.cache_policy = LRCExpertCachePolicy(
263	                num_layers=num_moe_layers,
264	                num_experts=self.num_total_experts,
265	                cache_size=self.num_device_experts,
266	                topk=self.topk,
267	                recent_window=self.offload_config.cache_recent_window,
268	                ema_beta=self.offload_config.cache_ema_beta,
269	                recent_weight=self.offload_config.cache_recent_weight,
270	                ema_weight=self.offload_config.cache_ema_weight,
271	                router_weight=self.offload_config.cache_router_weight,
272	                age_weight=self.offload_config.cache_age_weight,
273	            )
274	        t3 = time.perf_counter()
275	
276	        ntotal = self.num_total_experts
277	        self.topk_ids_h = torch.zeros(
278	            [self.offload_threshold, self.topk],
279	            dtype=torch.int32, device="cpu", pin_memory=True)
280	        self.topk_weights_h = torch.zeros(
281	            [self.offload_threshold, self.topk],
282	            dtype=torch.float32, device="cpu", pin_memory=True)
283	        self.log2phy_h = torch.zeros(ntotal, dtype=torch.int32,
284	                                     device='cpu', pin_memory=True)
285	        self.log2phy_np = self.log2phy_h.numpy()
286	        t4 = time.perf_counter()
287	
288	        self.refresh_fp32_scales()
289	        t5 = time.perf_counter()
290	        self.create_prefill_pool()
291	        t6 = time.perf_counter()
292	        if self.offload_config.expert_prefetch_enabled:
293	            self.register_gate_weights(model)
294	        t7 = time.perf_counter()
295	        logger.info(
296	            "[OFFLOAD] finalize breakdown: process_weights=%.1fs "
297	            "cache_policy=%.1fs buffers=%.1fs init_device=%.1fs "
298	            "prefill_pool=%.1fs gate=%.1fs | total=%.1fs",
299	            t2 - t1, t3 - t2, t4 - t3, t5 - t4, t6 - t5, t7 - t6, t7 - t0)
300	
301	    def process_weights_after_loading(self):
302	        """Convert resident CPU expert buffers to fractal NZ format (W8A8).
303	
304	        For W8A8 the device weight lives in NZ format, so we mirror that on
305	        the CPU side and page experts to the device with a raw copy_ on the
306	        underlying storage (avoids an implicit format cast on every H2D).
307	
308	        After this runs each w13/w2 CPU tensor still reports its original
309	        [hidden, ...] shape, but its storage holds NZ-format bytes — a "liar
310	        tensor". Touch it only via untyped_storage() slicing, never through
311	        the tensor view. No-op for non-int8 models.
312	        """
313	        first_w13 = self.w13_weights_cpu[0][0]
314	        if first_w13.dtype != torch.int8:
315	            return
316	        num_moe_layers = len(self.w13_weights_cpu)
317	        num_experts = len(self.w13_weights_cpu[0])
318	        for layer_id in range(num_moe_layers):
319	            w13 = torch.stack(self.w13_weights_cpu[layer_id]).to('npu')
320	            w13_nz = torch_npu.npu_format_cast(w13, ACL_FORMAT_FRACTAL_NZ)
321	            w13_nz_storage = w13_nz.untyped_storage()
322	            w2 = torch.stack(self.w2_weights_cpu[layer_id]).to('npu')
323	            w2_nz = torch_npu.npu_format_cast(w2, ACL_FORMAT_FRACTAL_NZ)
324	            w2_nz_storage = w2_nz.untyped_storage()
325	            for expert_id in range(num_experts):
326	                self.w13_weights_cpu[layer_id][expert_id].untyped_storage().copy_(
327	                    w13_nz_storage[expert_id * self.w13_expert_size_bytes : (expert_id + 1) * self.w13_expert_size_bytes]
328	                )
329	                self.w2_weights_cpu[layer_id][expert_id].untyped_storage().copy_(
330	                    w2_nz_storage[expert_id * self.w2_expert_size_bytes : (expert_id + 1) * self.w2_expert_size_bytes]
331	                )
332	
333	    def register_gate_weights(self, model):
334	        """Store fp32 CPU copies of gate.weight for each MoE layer.
335	
336	        Called from _finalize_offload() after all MoE layers are
337	        registered.  The gate weights are used by predict_next_layer_experts()
338	        to predict which experts the next layer will need.
339	        """
340	        from vllm_ascend.models.deepseek_v4 import DeepseekV4MoE
341	        moe_wrappers = [m for m in model.modules()
342	                        if isinstance(m, DeepseekV4MoE)]
343	        for wrapper in moe_wrappers:
344	            gate_cpu = wrapper.gate.weight.data.cpu().float().clone()
345	            self._gate_weights_cpu.append(gate_cpu)
346	            # Hash-MoE layers carry gate.tid2eid [V, topk] int32; non-hash → None.
347	            tid = wrapper.gate.tid2eid
348	            self._gate_tid2eid_cpu.append(
349	                tid.data.cpu().clone() if tid is not None else None)
350	        logger.info("[PREFETCH] registered gate weights for %d MoE layers "
351	                    "(%d hash)", len(self._gate_weights_cpu),
352	                    sum(t is not None for t in self._gate_tid2eid_cpu))
353	
354	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
355	    #  Deferred weight-load pool                                          #
356	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
357	    #
358	    # Weight loading is callback-driven: the safetensors loader calls
359	    # load_w13/load_w2/_load_scale_shard once per shard (~99k calls), serially
360	    # in the main thread. The per-call strided transpose-copy into pinned
361	    # memory is ~0.2 GB/s single-threaded, which dominated startup (~9 min).
362	    #
363	    # Strategy: each loader callback (a) owns the shard via a synchronous
364	    # .clone() while the safetensors mmap is still mapped, then (b) submits
365	    # the strided transpose-copy to a worker pool and returns immediately.
366	    # The main thread keeps pulling shards while the pool churns through
367	    # copies concurrently. drain_load_pool() barriers before _finalize_offload
368	    # reads the buffers. Because the deferred copy reads the owned clone (not
369	    # the mmap view), it stays correct after the safetensors mmap is unmapped
370	    # (which happens before _finalize_offload runs).
371	
372	    def _get_load_pool(self) -> ThreadPoolExecutor:
373	        if self._load_pool is None:
374	            # Pin torch intra-op threads to 1: otherwise each copy_ spawns
375	            # nproc libgomp threads and 32 workers x 640 cores exhausts the
376	            # thread limit (EAGAIN). Parallelism comes from the pool itself.
377	            self._saved_num_threads = torch.get_num_threads()
378	            torch.set_num_threads(1)
379	            self._load_pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(
380	                max_workers=self._LOAD_POOL_WORKERS,
381	                thread_name_prefix="offload-load")
382	            self._load_phase_start = time.perf_counter()
383	            logger.info(
384	                "[OFFLOAD] starting parallel weight load (workers=%d)",
385	                self._LOAD_POOL_WORKERS)
386	        return self._load_pool
387	
388	    def _track_load_future(self, fut) -> None:
389	        self._load_futures.append(fut)
390	        if len(self._load_futures) >= self._LOAD_POOL_DRAIN_EVERY:
391	            self._drain_futures()
392	
393	    def _drain_futures(self) -> None:
394	        if not self._load_futures:
395	            return
396	        # f.result() re-raises any worker exception (e.g. shape mismatch).
397	        for f in self._load_futures:
398	            f.result()
399	        self._load_futures.clear()
400	
401	    def drain_load_pool(self) -> None:
402	        """Wait for all deferred weight copies to finish.
403	
404	        Safe to call after the safetensors mmap is unmapped: deferred copies
405	        read owned clones, not mmap views.
406	        """
407	        self._drain_futures()
408	        if self._load_pool is not None:
409	            self._load_pool.shutdown(wait=True)
410	            self._load_pool = None
411	            if self._saved_num_threads is not None:
412	                torch.set_num_threads(self._saved_num_threads)
413	                self._saved_num_threads = None
414	            self._weight_load_secs = time.perf_counter() - self._load_phase_start
415	
416	    # -- worker copy kernels (static: no self, no shared mutable state) -- #
417	
418	    @staticmethod
419	    def _copy_w13_shard(cpu: torch.Tensor, owned: torch.Tensor,
420	                        shard_id: str, intermed: int) -> None:
421	        if shard_id == "w1":
422	            cpu[:, :intermed].copy_(owned.t())
423	        elif shard_id == "w3":
424	            cpu[:, intermed: intermed + owned.shape[0]].copy_(owned.t())
425	
426	    @staticmethod
427	    def _copy_w2(dst: torch.Tensor, owned: torch.Tensor) -> None:
428	        dst.copy_(owned.t())
429	
430	    @staticmethod
431	    def _copy_scale_assembled(target: torch.Tensor,
432	                              w1: torch.Tensor, w3: torch.Tensor) -> None:
433	        assembled = torch.cat([w1, w3], dim=0).reshape(target.shape)
434	        target.copy_(assembled)
435	
436	    @staticmethod
437	    def _copy_scale_direct(target: torch.Tensor, owned: torch.Tensor) -> None:
438	        target.copy_(owned.reshape(target.shape))
439	
440	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
441	    #  Weight-load entry points (called by the safetensors loader)        #
442	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
443	
444	    def load_w13(self, layer_moe_idx: int, expert_id: int,
445	                 loaded_weight: torch.Tensor, shard_id: str):
446	        """Store w1/w3 shard to CPU buffer (transposed) via the load pool."""
447	        self._weight_load_calls += 1
448	        cpu = self.w13_weights_cpu[layer_moe_idx][expert_id]
449	        intermed = cpu.shape[1] // 2
450	        # Own the bytes now (the mmap may unmap before the worker runs).
451	        owned = loaded_weight.cpu().clone()
452	        fut = self._get_load_pool().submit(
453	            self._copy_w13_shard, cpu, owned, shard_id, intermed)
454	        self._track_load_future(fut)
455	
456	    def load_w2(self, layer_moe_idx: int, expert_id: int,
457	                loaded_weight: torch.Tensor):
458	        """Store w2 weight to CPU buffer (transposed) via the load pool."""
459	        self._weight_load_calls += 1
460	        dst = self.w2_weights_cpu[layer_moe_idx][expert_id]
461	        owned = loaded_weight.cpu().clone()
462	        fut = self._get_load_pool().submit(self._copy_w2, dst, owned)
463	        self._track_load_future(fut)
464	
465	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
466	    #  Scale / offset helpers (quantized models only)                     #
467	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
468	
469	    def _load_scale_shard(self, layer_moe_idx: int, expert_id: int,
470	                          attr_name: str, shard_id: str,
471	                          loaded_weight: torch.Tensor):
472	        """Load a scale/offset shard into its CPU buffer via the load pool.
473	
474	        w13 scale/offset arrives as two shards (w1, w3) that must be
475	        concatenated along dim 0. We stash the first-arriving owned clone in
476	        _scale_shard_temp and assemble when the second shard arrives.
477	        w2 scale/offset is a single shard — clone and defer directly.
478	        """
479	        self._weight_load_calls += 1
480	        assert shard_id in ("w1", "w2", "w3"), f"unexpected shard_id: {shard_id}"
481	        target_dict = (self.scale_cpu_buffers if "scale" in attr_name
482	                       else self.offset_cpu_buffers)
483	        target = target_dict[attr_name][layer_moe_idx][expert_id]
484	        if attr_name.startswith("w13_"):
485	            key = (layer_moe_idx, expert_id, attr_name)
486	            pending_shard = self._scale_shard_temp.pop(key, None)
487	            if pending_shard is not None:
488	                # Second shard — own it, then defer cat + copy.
489	                cur_shard = loaded_weight.cpu().clone()
490	                if shard_id == "w1":
491	                    w1, w3 = cur_shard, pending_shard
492	                else:
493	                    w1, w3 = pending_shard, cur_shard
494	                fut = self._get_load_pool().submit(
495	                    self._copy_scale_assembled, target, w1, w3)
496	                self._track_load_future(fut)
497	            else:
498	                # First shard — stash an owned clone.
499	                self._scale_shard_temp[key] = loaded_weight.cpu().clone()
500	        else:
501	            # w2 scale/offset — single shard.
502	            owned = loaded_weight.cpu().clone()
503	            fut = self._get_load_pool().submit(
504	                self._copy_scale_direct, target, owned)
505	            self._track_load_future(fut)
506	
507	    def refresh_fp32_scales(self):
508	        """Recompute the derived fp32 per-expert scale after weight loading.
509	
510	        Device experts are already in place (loaded by the weight loader and
511	        process_weights_after_loading); this only refreshes
512	        w13_weight_scale_fp32 from the freshly-loaded w13_weight_scale.
513	        """
514	        for i, layer in enumerate(self.moe_layers):
515	            ndev = min(self.num_device_experts, layer.w13_weight.shape[0])
516	            if hasattr(layer, 'w13_weight_scale_fp32'):
517	                for j in range(ndev):
518	                    layer.w13_weight_scale_fp32[j].copy_(
519	                        layer.w13_weight_scale.data[j].to(torch.float32))
520	
521	    def create_prefill_pool(self):
522	        """Allocate prefill pool tensors on NPU with full expert count.
523	
524	        Called from _finalize_offload() after decode buffers are set up.
525	        Creates ndl device tensors each holding all experts (e.g. 128).
526	        These are used when num_tokens > offload_threshold (large-batch
527	        prefill), loaded via full-overwrite in _prefill_load_layer.
528	        """
529	        if self._prefill_initialized:
530	            return
531	        if not self.moe_layers:
532	            return
533	        ndl = self.num_device_layers
534	        pool_layer = self.moe_layers[0]
535	        dev = pool_layer.w13_weight.device
536	        dt = pool_layer.w13_weight.dtype
537	        ntotal = self.num_total_experts
538	
539	        for _ in range(ndl):
540	            # w13: [ntotal, hidden_size, w13_up_dim] — match decode layer shape
541	            w13_shape = (ntotal,) + tuple(pool_layer.w13_weight.shape[1:])
542	            self._prefill_w13.append(
543	                torch.empty(w13_shape, dtype=dt, device=dev))
544	
545	            # w2: [ntotal, hidden_size, intermediate_size_per_partition]
546	            w2_shape = (ntotal,) + tuple(pool_layer.w2_weight.shape[1:])
547	            self._prefill_w2.append(
548	                torch.empty(w2_shape, dtype=dt, device=dev))
549	
550	            # W8A8 scale/offset (optional)
551	            if hasattr(pool_layer, 'w13_weight_scale'):
552	                s13_shape = (ntotal,) + tuple(pool_layer.w13_weight_scale.shape[1:])
553	                self._prefill_w13_scale.append(
554	                    torch.empty(s13_shape, dtype=pool_layer.w13_weight_scale.dtype, device=dev))
555	            if hasattr(pool_layer, 'w13_weight_scale_fp32'):
556	                fp32_13_shape = (ntotal,) + tuple(pool_layer.w13_weight_scale_fp32.shape[1:])
557	                self._prefill_w13_scale_fp32.append(
558	                    torch.empty(fp32_13_shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev))
559	            if hasattr(pool_layer, 'w13_weight_offset'):
560	                o13_shape = (ntotal,) + tuple(pool_layer.w13_weight_offset.shape[1:])
561	                self._prefill_w13_offset.append(
562	                    torch.empty(o13_shape, dtype=pool_layer.w13_weight_offset.dtype, device=dev))
563	            if hasattr(pool_layer, 'w2_weight_scale'):
564	                s2_shape = (ntotal,) + tuple(pool_layer.w2_weight_scale.shape[1:])
565	                self._prefill_w2_scale.append(
566	                    torch.empty(s2_shape, dtype=pool_layer.w2_weight_scale.dtype, device=dev))
567	            if hasattr(pool_layer, 'w2_weight_offset'):
568	                o2_shape = (ntotal,) + tuple(pool_layer.w2_weight_offset.shape[1:])
569	                self._prefill_w2_offset.append(
570	                    torch.empty(o2_shape, dtype=pool_layer.w2_weight_offset.dtype, device=dev))
571	
572	        # Cast prefill pool weight tensors to NZ format (W8A8 kernel requires it).
573	        # Must happen BEFORE loading data — same order as decode path:
574	        # create → NZ-cast → copy_(cpu → npu)
575	        if dt == torch.int8:
576	            from vllm_ascend.utils import ACL_FORMAT_FRACTAL_NZ
577	            for i in range(ndl):
578	                self._prefill_w13[i] = torch_npu.npu_format_cast(
579	                    self._prefill_w13[i], ACL_FORMAT_FRACTAL_NZ)
580	                self._prefill_w2[i] = torch_npu.npu_format_cast(
581	                    self._prefill_w2[i], ACL_FORMAT_FRACTAL_NZ)
582	
583	        # Prefill log2phy: identity — all experts mapped to their slots
584	        self._prefill_log2phy = torch.arange(ntotal, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
585	
586	        # Pre-initialize all pool slots with layer 0 weights so that
587	        # profile_run / _dummy_run (which may use prefill path) has
588	        # valid data.  Subsequent _prefill_load_layer calls will
589	        # overwrite with the correct per-layer weights.
590	        self._init_prefill_pool_data(dev, ntotal, ndl)
591	        self._prefill_initialized = True
592	        logger.info("[PREFILL_POOL] allocated %d layers × %d experts, "
593	                    "w13[0].shape=%s w2[0].shape=%s",
594	                    ndl, ntotal,
595	                    tuple(self._prefill_w13[0].shape),
596	                    tuple(self._prefill_w2[0].shape))
597	
598	    def _init_prefill_pool_data(self, dev, ntotal: int, ndl: int):
599	        """Load layer 0 weights into all prefill pool slots.
600	
601	        Prefill pool tensors are already NZ-cast at this point (done in
602	        create_prefill_pool). Use simple per-expert copy_() — same pattern
603	        as the decode path's _update_weights.
604	        """
605	        has_scales = bool(self._prefill_w13_scale)
606	        has_offsets = bool(self._prefill_w13_offset)
607	
608	        for slot in range(ndl):
609	            for eid in range(min(ntotal, len(self.w13_weights_cpu[0]))):
610	                self._prefill_w13[slot].untyped_storage()[eid * self.w13_expert_size_bytes : (eid + 1) * self.w13_expert_size_bytes].copy_(
611	                    self.w13_weights_cpu[0][eid].untyped_storage()
612	                )
613	                self._prefill_w2[slot].untyped_storage()[eid * self.w2_expert_size_bytes : (eid + 1) * self.w2_expert_size_bytes].copy_(
614	                    self.w2_weights_cpu[0][eid].untyped_storage()
615	                )
616	
617	            # Initialize scale/offset buffers with layer 0 data (W8A8)
618	            if has_scales:
619	                for scale_name, prefill_list, cpu_buffers in [
620	                    ("w13_weight_scale", self._prefill_w13_scale, self.scale_cpu_buffers),
621	                    ("w2_weight_scale", self._prefill_w2_scale, self.scale_cpu_buffers),
622	                ]:
623	                    if (scale_name in cpu_buffers and
624	                            0 < len(cpu_buffers[scale_name])):
625	                        for eid in range(min(ntotal, len(cpu_buffers[scale_name][0]))):
626	                            prefill_list[slot][eid].copy_(
627	                                cpu_buffers[scale_name][0][eid])
628	            if has_offsets:
629	                for offset_name, prefill_list, cpu_buffers in [
630	                    ("w13_weight_offset", self._prefill_w13_offset, self.offset_cpu_buffers),
631	                    ("w2_weight_offset", self._prefill_w2_offset, self.offset_cpu_buffers),
632	                ]:
633	                    if (offset_name in cpu_buffers and
634	                            0 < len(cpu_buffers[offset_name])):
635	                        for eid in range(min(ntotal, len(cpu_buffers[offset_name][0]))):
636	                            prefill_list[slot][eid].copy_(
637	                                cpu_buffers[offset_name][0][eid])
638	            # Initialize fp32 scale (convert from scale)
639	            if has_scales and slot < len(self._prefill_w13_scale_fp32):
640	                for eid in range(min(ntotal, self._prefill_w13_scale[slot].shape[0])):
641	                    self._prefill_w13_scale_fp32[slot][eid].copy_(
642	                        self._prefill_w13_scale[slot][eid].to(torch.float32))
643	
644	    def _prefill_load_layer(self, layer_idx: int, log2phy: torch.Tensor):
645	        """Load ALL experts for model layer layer_idx into the prefill pool.
646	
647	        For W8A8: loads into normal-format scratch, then casts to NZ.
648	        For unquantized: loads directly into pool tensors via copy_().
649	        Full-overwrite into pool_slot = layer_idx % ndl.  No slot_owner
650	        tracking needed — log2phy is set to identity for prefill.
651	        """
652	        ndl = self.num_device_layers
653	        pool_slot = layer_idx % ndl
654	        dev = self._prefill_w13[pool_slot].device
655	        ntotal = self.num_total_experts
656	        is_w8a8 = self._prefill_w13[pool_slot].dtype == torch.int8
657	
658	        if self._debug:
659	            logger.info("[PREFILL_LOAD] layer=%d pool_slot=%d ntotal=%d is_w8a8=%s",
660	                        layer_idx, pool_slot, ntotal, is_w8a8)
661	
662	        from vllm_ascend.utils import ACL_FORMAT_FRACTAL_NZ
663	
664	        with torch_npu.npu.stream(self.load_stream):
665	            for eid in range(ntotal):
666	                self._prefill_w13[pool_slot].untyped_storage()[eid * self.w13_expert_size_bytes : (eid + 1) * self.w13_expert_size_bytes].copy_(
667	                    self.w13_weights_cpu[layer_idx][eid].untyped_storage()
668	                )
669	                self._prefill_w2[pool_slot].untyped_storage()[eid * self.w2_expert_size_bytes : (eid + 1) * self.w2_expert_size_bytes].copy_(
670	                    self.w2_weights_cpu[layer_idx][eid].untyped_storage()
671	                )
672	
673	            # W8A8 scale/offset — load into prefill buffers
674	            for scale_name, prefill_list, cpu_buffers in [
675	                ("w13_weight_scale", self._prefill_w13_scale, self.scale_cpu_buffers),
676	                ("w2_weight_scale", self._prefill_w2_scale, self.scale_cpu_buffers),
677	            ]:
678	                if pool_slot < len(prefill_list):
679	                    if (scale_name in cpu_buffers and
680	                            layer_idx < len(cpu_buffers[scale_name])):
681	                        for eid in range(min(ntotal, len(cpu_buffers[scale_name][layer_idx]))):
682	                            prefill_list[pool_slot][eid].copy_(
683	                                cpu_buffers[scale_name][layer_idx][eid])
684	            for offset_name, prefill_list, cpu_buffers in [
685	                ("w13_weight_offset", self._prefill_w13_offset, self.offset_cpu_buffers),
686	                ("w2_weight_offset", self._prefill_w2_offset, self.offset_cpu_buffers),
687	            ]:
688	                if pool_slot < len(prefill_list):
689	                    if (offset_name in cpu_buffers and
690	                            layer_idx < len(cpu_buffers[offset_name])):
691	                        for eid in range(min(ntotal, len(cpu_buffers[offset_name][layer_idx]))):
692	                            prefill_list[pool_slot][eid].copy_(
693	                                cpu_buffers[offset_name][layer_idx][eid])
694	
695	            # Refresh fp32 scale for prefill pool
696	            if (pool_slot < len(self._prefill_w13_scale_fp32) and
697	                    pool_slot < len(self._prefill_w13_scale)):
698	                # Copy scale data from freshly loaded scale to fp32
699	                for eid in range(min(ntotal, self._prefill_w13_scale[pool_slot].shape[0])):
700	                    self._prefill_w13_scale_fp32[pool_slot][eid].copy_(
701	                        self._prefill_w13_scale[pool_slot][eid].to(torch.float32))
702	
703	            self.load_stream.synchronize()
704	
705	        # NOTE: Do NOT modify the layer's own log2phy here — decode path
706	        # relies on it staying with 32-expert mapping.  Prefill path in
707	        # apply() explicitly uses self._prefill_log2phy instead.
708	
709	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
710	    #  Forward path: page in experts based on topk_ids                    #
711	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
712	
713	    def update_weights(self, layer, topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
714	                        log2phy: torch.Tensor,
715	                        topk_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
716	                        hidden_states: torch.Tensor | None = None) -> int:
717	        """Incrementally page in needed experts, overwriting unused slots.
718	
719	        Routes to prefill pool (full-overwrite) when num_tokens exceeds
720	        offload_threshold, otherwise uses per-expert paging (decode path).
721	
722	        Args:
723	            layer: AscendFusedMoE instance.
724	            topk_ids: [num_tokens, top_k] routed expert indices.
725	            log2phy: [global_num_experts] CPU tensor, modified in-place.
726	            topk_weights: Optional routing weights for cache policy.
727	            hidden_states: Optional [num_tokens, hidden_dim] tensor used
728	                           for next-layer expert prefetch prediction.
729	
730	        Returns: number of CPU→NPU copies performed (decode path),
731	                 0 for prefill path (full-overwrite via pool).
732	        """
733	        num_tokens = topk_ids.size(0)
734	        if num_tokens > self.offload_threshold:
735	            # Prefill: layerwise reuse + full-overwrite of all experts
736	            if (self._prefill_initialized
737	                    and not self._skip_prefill):
738	                try:
739	                    layer_idx = self.moe_layers.index(layer)
740	                except ValueError:
741	                    return 0
742	                self._prefill_load_layer(layer_idx, log2phy)
743	                return 0
744	            else:
745	                # Profile run or pool not ready — bail out gracefully
746	                return 0
747	
748	        try:
749	            layer_idx = self.moe_layers.index(layer)
750	        except ValueError:
751	            return 0
752	
753	        current_compute_stream = torch_npu.npu.current_stream()
754	        subscribed_compute_streams = get_subscribed_compute_streams()
755	        if current_compute_stream not in subscribed_compute_streams:
756	            torch_npu.npu._subscribe_report(current_compute_stream)
757	            subscribed_compute_streams.add(current_compute_stream)
758	
759	        # Wait for pending prefetch before reading log2phy.
760	        # Graph path (hash layers): launch a non-blocking wait host-fn (stream
761	        # wait_event) BEFORE the captured copy_(log2phy) below. Register it for
762	        # ALL hash layers during capture (the event slot is populated at replay
763	        # by the issue host-fn; if absent, _prefetch_wait_host no-ops).
764	        # Eager path: host-block on the daemon's done event + NPU event.
765	        if (_EXTRA_CTX.capturing
766	                and layer_idx < self.num_hash_layers):
767	            torch_npu.npu._launch_host_func(
768	                current_compute_stream, self._prefetch_wait_host, (layer_idx,))
769	        else:
770	            layer_done = self._prefetch_layer_done.get(layer_idx)
771	            if layer_done is not None:
772	                layer_done.wait()
773	                layer_done.clear()
774	                del self._prefetch_layer_done[layer_idx]
775	                with self._prefetch_state_lock:
776	                    npu_event = self._prefetch_layer_npu_event.pop(layer_idx,
777	                                                                    None)
778	                if npu_event is not None:
779	                    npu_event.synchronize()
780	
781	        topk_ids_h = self.topk_ids_h[:num_tokens]
782	        topk_weights_h = None
783	        if (self.cache_policy is not None and topk_weights is not None and not _EXTRA_CTX.capturing
784	                and self.offload_config.cache_router_weight != 0):
785	            topk_weights_h = self.topk_weights_h[:num_tokens]
786	            topk_weights_h.copy_(topk_weights.to(dtype=torch.float32), non_blocking=False)
787	        log2phy_h = self.log2phy_h
788	        log2phy_np = self.log2phy_np
789	        topk_ids_h.copy_(topk_ids, non_blocking=_EXTRA_CTX.capturing)
790	        log2phy_h.copy_(log2phy, non_blocking=_EXTRA_CTX.capturing)
791	
792	        args = (
793	            topk_ids_h,
794	            log2phy_np,
795	            layer,
796	            layer_idx,
797	            topk_weights_h,
798	        )
799	        if _EXTRA_CTX.capturing:
800	            torch_npu.npu._launch_host_func(
801	                current_compute_stream,
802	                self._update_weights,
803	                args,
804	            )
805	        else:
806	            self._update_weights(args)
807	
808	        log2phy.copy_(log2phy_h, non_blocking=_EXTRA_CTX.capturing)
809	
810	    def _update_weights(self, args):
811	        (
812	            topk_ids_h,
813	            log2phy_np,
814	            layer,
815	            layer_idx,
816	            topk_weights_h,
817	        ) = args
818	        with torch_npu.npu.stream(self.load_stream):
819	            if self.cache_policy is not None:
820	                router_scores = topk_weights_h.tolist() if topk_weights_h is not None else None
821	                needed = self.cache_policy.observe(
822	                    layer_idx,
823	                    topk_ids_h.tolist(),
824	                    router_scores=router_scores,
825	                )
826	            else:
827	                needed = set(topk_ids_h.unique().tolist())
828	
829	            # Build reverse map: slot → expert_id currently occupying it
830	            slot_owner: dict[int, int] = {}
831	            for eid, slot in enumerate(log2phy_np):
832	                if slot >= 0:
833	                    slot_owner[slot] = eid
834	
835	            on_device = set(slot_owner.values())
836	            already_there = needed & on_device           # no-op
837	            need_to_load = needed - already_there          # CPU→NPU copy
838	            if self.cache_policy is not None:
839	                self._record_cache_stats(layer_idx, already_there, need_to_load, needed, on_device)
840	            reusable_slots = [s for s, e in slot_owner.items()
841	                            if e not in needed]          # slots to recycle
842	
843	            if self.cache_policy is not None and self._debug:
844	                logger.info("[UPDATE-W] l=%d expert_hit=%s expert_miss=%s hit_rate=%.2f",
845	                            layer_idx, sorted(already_there),
846	                            sorted(need_to_load), len(already_there) / 6)
847	                if need_to_load and len(need_to_load) > len(reusable_slots):
848	                    logger.info("[UPDATE-W] l=%d SHORTFALL: need %d load but only %d slots, "
849	                                "to_load=%s",
850	                                layer_idx, len(need_to_load), len(reusable_slots),
851	                                sorted(need_to_load)[:20])
852	
853	            dev = layer.w13_weight.device
854	            n_copies = 0
855	            for eid in need_to_load:
856	                if self.cache_policy is not None:
857	                    victim = self.cache_policy.choose_victim(
858	                        layer_idx,
859	                        slot_owner,
860	                        protected=needed,
861	                    )
862	                    slot = int(log2phy_np[victim]) if victim is not None else -1
863	                elif reusable_slots:
864	                    slot = reusable_slots.pop()
865	                    victim = slot_owner[slot]
866	                else:
867	                    slot = -1
868	                    victim = None
869	
870	                if slot < 0:
871	                    if self._debug:
872	                        logger.info(
873	                            "[UPDATE-W] l=%d NO SLOTS: %d experts could not be loaded, "
874	                            "missed=%s",
875	                            layer_idx, len(need_to_load) - n_copies,
876	                            sorted(list(need_to_load))[n_copies:][:20])
877	                    break  # no free slots — should not happen in normal usage
878	                # Copy weights from CPU to NPU
879	                layer.w13_weight.data.untyped_storage()[slot * self.w13_expert_size_bytes : (slot + 1) * self.w13_expert_size_bytes].copy_(
880	                    self.w13_weights_cpu[layer_idx][eid].untyped_storage()
881	                )
882	                layer.w2_weight.data.untyped_storage()[slot * self.w2_expert_size_bytes : (slot + 1) * self.w2_expert_size_bytes].copy_(
883	                    self.w2_weights_cpu[layer_idx][eid].untyped_storage()
884	                )
885	                # Copy scales/offsets from CPU to NPU
886	                for attr_name, buffers in self.scale_cpu_buffers.items():
887	                    if layer_idx >= len(buffers) or eid >= len(buffers[layer_idx]):
888	                        continue
889	                    dev_tensor = getattr(layer, attr_name, None)
890	                    if dev_tensor is None:
891	                        continue
892	                    dev_tensor.data[slot].copy_(buffers[layer_idx][eid])
893	                for attr_name, buffers in self.offset_cpu_buffers.items():
894	                    if layer_idx >= len(buffers) or eid >= len(buffers[layer_idx]):
895	                        continue
896	                    dev_tensor = getattr(layer, attr_name, None)
897	                    if dev_tensor is None:
898	                        continue
899	                    dev_tensor.data[slot].copy_(buffers[layer_idx][eid])
900	                # Refresh derived fp32 scale if present (W8A8_DYNAMIC)
901	                if hasattr(layer, 'w13_weight_scale_fp32'):
902	                    layer.w13_weight_scale_fp32[slot].copy_(
903	                        layer.w13_weight_scale.data[slot].to(torch.float32))
904	                # Update mapping
905	                if victim is None:
906	                    victim = slot_owner[slot]
907	                log2phy_np[victim] = -1             # evict old occupant
908	                log2phy_np[eid] = slot               # assign slot to new expert
909	                slot_owner[slot] = eid
910	                if slot in reusable_slots:
911	                    reusable_slots.remove(slot)
912	                n_copies += 1
913	
914	            self.load_stream.synchronize()

916	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
917	    #  Next-layer expert prefetch                                          #
918	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
919	
920	    def predict_next_layer_experts(
921	        self,
922	        layer_idx: int,
923	        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
924	    ) -> set[int] | None:
925	        """Predict which experts layer layer_idx+1 will need.
926	
927	        Uses the current layer's hidden_states as an approximation of
928	        the next layer's input, multiplied by the next layer's gate weight
929	        to get predicted router logits.  A simplified softmax + topk is
930	        used instead of the full grouped_topk for speed; misses are
931	        handled by the reactive fallback in update_weights().
932	
933	        Args:
934	            layer_idx: Current layer index.
935	            hidden_states: [num_tokens, hidden_dim] NPU tensor.
936	
937	        Returns:
938	            Set of predicted expert IDs, or None if prediction is not
939	            possible (e.g. last layer, no gate weight).
940	        """
941	        next_idx = layer_idx + 1
942	        if next_idx >= len(self.moe_layers):
943	            return None  # last layer — nothing to prefetch
944	
945	        # Hash-MoE layers select experts by tid2eid[input_ids] (token-id
946	        # determined, not hidden-state dependent) — predict EXACTLY from the
947	        # lookup instead of the gate-softmax approximation (which is wrong for
948	        # hash layers, since their selection doesn't go through the gate).
949	        if next_idx < self.num_hash_layers:
950	            tid2eid = (self._gate_tid2eid_cpu[next_idx]
951	                       if next_idx < len(self._gate_tid2eid_cpu) else None)
952	            if tid2eid is None:
953	                return None
954	            # Graph-mode host-fns run on the ACL callback thread, where the
955	            # forward context is NOT set — prefer the stashed decode input_ids.
956	            input_ids = self._decode_input_ids
957	            if input_ids is None:
958	                input_ids = get_forward_context().input_ids
959	            if input_ids is None:
960	                return None
961	            ids_cpu = input_ids.cpu()
962	            return set(tid2eid[ids_cpu].flatten().tolist())
963	
964	        # Gate layers: approximate next-layer routing via the gate weight.
965	        if next_idx >= len(self._gate_weights_cpu):
966	            return None
967	        gate_w = self._gate_weights_cpu[next_idx]
968	        if gate_w is None:
969	            return None
970	
971	        # Move hidden_states to CPU for prediction (tiny in decode: 1-8 tokens)
972	        hs_cpu = hidden_states.float().cpu()
973	        router_logits = F.linear(hs_cpu, gate_w)  # [num_tokens, n_experts]
974	
975	        # Simplified routing: softmax + topk (approximation)
976	        probs = router_logits.softmax(dim=-1)
977	        _, topk_ids = probs.topk(self.topk, dim=-1)
978	        return set(topk_ids.flatten().tolist())
979	
980	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
981	    #  Threaded prefetch: background thread for expert weight loading     #
982	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
